component.name: gallery-dl
component.summary: Download image galleries and collections from the command line

description.p: gallery-dl downloads image galleries and collections from several hundred image hosting sites. It runs in a terminal and supports custom file names, download archives, logins and filters.

Optional add-ons provide video downloads with yt-dlp, SOCKS proxies, Brotli-compressed responses, YAML configuration, the desktop keyring, PostgreSQL archives, system certificates, Jinja templates and accurate Ugoira timing with mkvmerge.
This is an unofficial Flatpak build of the upstream project.
New extractors for Steam Community screenshots and artworks and for Pornhub avatars and banners, two more Mastodon instances, and fixes for several sites.
